lines.quote: This function takes a sorted list and a target value.
lines.fix: The function definition takes a sorted list and a target.

lines.quote: It keeps two pointers, low and high,
lines.fix: Initialises lo and hi to the start and end indices.

lines.quote: Each time it checks the middle element,
lines.fix: Computes mid as the integer average of lo and hi.

lines.quote: if it finds the element it returns minus one.
lines.fix: Checks if arr[mid] equals the target.

lines.quote: and if it finds the element it returns minus one.
lines.fix: Returns the index mid when the target is found.

lines.quote: if the middle is smaller than the target it moves the low pointer up
lines.fix: If arr[mid] < target, set lo = mid + 1.

lines.quote: otherwise it moves the high pointer down
lines.fix: Else case for when arr[mid] > target.
Returns -1 if the target is not found after the loop.
